prompt.project_info: Create a realistic indoor cosplay portrait of an original approved adult woman in an original spider-inspired costume.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult Asian woman with dark brown-to-black hair in long high twin-tails, soft bangs, a playful wink and tongue-out expression holds both pigtails with gloved hands. Preserve the glossy black form-fitting bodysuit, original white spider-inspired emblem, gray honeycomb-patterned sleeves and gloves, and faint gray geometric torso details.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium portrait from mid-thigh up, slight above-eye-level angle, forward-leaning playful stance, both arms raised with hands gripping the pigtails, face and gloves in sharp focus, plain beige corner walls, neutral floor, and soft shadow behind the subject.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffuse frontal and slightly overhead indoor lighting, gentle shadow under chin, subtle specular highlights on the glossy costume, playful energetic cosplay mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic 35–50mm portrait photography, vertical 4:5, moderate depth of field, natural skin and fabric physics, clean amateur snapshot feel, restrained color and no artificial HDR look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic vertical 4:5 cosplay portrait of an original approved adult Asian woman with dark brown-to-black hair in long high twin-tails and soft bangs, winking and sticking out her tongue while holding both pigtails with gloved hands. Preserve the glossy black form-fitting bodysuit, original white spider-inspired emblem, gray honeycomb-patterned sleeves and gloves, and faint gray geometric torso details. Medium framing from mid-thigh up, slight above-eye-level angle, forward-leaning playful stance, plain beige corner walls, neutral floor, soft diffuse indoor lighting, natural skin and costume texture, subtle glossy highlights.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, childlike features, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, copyrighted character dependence, graphic violence, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, over-saturated, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, unreadable text

assets.name: black spider-inspired cosplay reference
assets.usage: Match the original adult model, twin-tails, expression, gloves, glossy bodysuit, emblem, beige room, and soft light.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve adult identity, face, hair, pose, costume silhouette, emblem placement, environment, and lighting. Keep the spider graphic original and replaceable; do not copy a named copyrighted character, logos, or typography.
